components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Used for primary actions like Transmit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #555555; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Used for secondary actions and confirmation options.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #111111; padding: 0.375rem 1rem; font-family: 'Menlo', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border: 1px solid #111111; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fcfcfc; color: #111111; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-family: 'Menlo', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 0; outline: none; width: 100%; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #111111; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #555555; }

components.name: Confidence Badge
components.description: Used to indicate data confidence levels.
components.css: .ds-badge-high, .ds-badge-med { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 4px; font-family: 'Menlo', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; border-radius: 0; border: 1px solid; } .ds-badge-high { color: #16a34a; border-color: #16a34a; background: rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.1); } .ds-badge-med { color: #d97706; border-color: #d97706; background: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.1); margin-left: 8px; }

narrative.overview: AirportIQ is a data-dense, brutalist, and highly functional analytical interface. It evokes the feeling of air traffic control systems and terminal dashboards: high contrast, zero ornamentation, and absolute clarity. The aesthetic relies entirely on typography, strict borders, and a stark black-and-white foundation with semantic color used only for data status.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace-heavy typography for data and labels.
High-contrast, stark black and white foundation (`ink` and `paper`).
Zero border radius; all corners are perfectly sharp.
Semantic colors (amber, red, green) strictly reserved for status, confidence, and warnings.

rules.name: The Semantic Strictness Rule
rules.body: Semantic colors (green, amber, red) are never used for decoration. They appear only to convey data status, confidence levels, or system warnings.

rules.name: The Mono-Data Rule
rules.body: Any numerical value, system status, or metadata label must be set in the monospace font.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Shadows are not used for structure or hierarchy.

rules.name: The Razor Edge Rule
rules.body: There are no rounded corners anywhere in the system. Every button, input, card, and badge has a 0px border radius.

dos: Do use 1px borders to separate dense information.
Do use uppercase monospace with wide tracking for labels and metadata.
Do keep all corners perfectly sharp (0px radius).
donts: Don't use rounded corners on any element.
Don't use shadows for elevation or hierarchy.
Don't use semantic colors (green, amber, red) for structural or decorative elements.
